rejections.reason: Original coordinate crop shows the own grey left wall bulging to roughly x449 near y498–501. The proposed x450 could shave a blur-width strip of cassette material. Source geometry is the conservative choice for this quick pass.
rejections.independent_agreement: Author and root both independently agreed with withdrawal before re-export.

material_ownership_checks.finding: Apparent projecting material above the tightened right side belongs to the cassette above; the lower own front and shaded wall remain enclosed.
Raw full-front crops support retaining the own rounded right walls while excluding a narrow external separator; the proposed bounds do not visibly shave the wall.

limits: The approximately 1px optical contour transition limits physical precision. Decimal coordinates are reproducible choices, not subpixel certainty. Acceptance is a conservative material-ownership review of the declared edits; it does not certify hidden or unflagged contours and does not justify more trimming.

inspection_previews.note: These hashes identify temporary inspection views. Original image pixels remain in the repository; exact accepted coordinates are in visual-audit.json. The rejected-case coordinate crop is retained beside this receipt.
